provenance_warning.issue: The 2026 Geoscience Data Journal article's dataset-detail list associates DOI 10.26023/ZH7Z-GRWB-AV0F with the SWEX radar wind profiler/RASS product. The current UCAR/DASH catalog resolves the SWEX profiler product itself as DOI 10.26023/2659-AF70-3009, alternate identifier 600.034, and lists SWEX-specific filenames and 2022 coverage. DOI 10.26023/ZH7Z-GRWB-AV0F is not used by this project for SWEX ingestion unless NCAR metadata later reconciles the discrepancy.
provenance_warning.resolution: Use UCAR dataset catalog metadata and alternate ID 600.034 as the ingestion authority; retain the publication mismatch in provenance.

sounding_composite_provenance.authority: NSF NCAR Earth Observing Laboratory / UCAR DASH dataset catalog
sounding_composite_provenance.reason: The SWEX multi-network composites harmonize NCAR/EOL, UCSB, San Jose State, NWS and aircraft sounding sources into one common format. The 5 hPa product is the primary cross-network validation layer; the native-resolution composite is retained for sensitivity analysis so vertical smoothing cannot silently determine the result.
sounding_composite_provenance.independence_rule: SWEX soundings are event-level observations and are never used as future predictors in fixed-24h HRRR holdout scoring.
